name: 083_attention_score_value_matmul
description: Fused attention score-value matrix multiplication that computes attention_weights @ V followed by transpose and reshape. This is the second major matmul in attention (after QK^T softmax) and appears in every self-attention and cross-attention layer throughout SDXL UNet.
axes: {"batch_size": {"type": "var", "description": "Batch size"}, "num_heads": {"type": "const", "value": 20, "description": "Number of attention heads"}, "head_dim": {"type": "const", "value": 64, "description": "Dimension per attention head"}, "hidden_size": {"type": "const", "value": 1280, "description": "Hidden size (num_heads * head_dim)"}, "seq_len_q": {"type": "var", "description": "Query sequence length (spatial resolution H*W)"}, "seq_len_kv": {"type": "var", "description": "Key/Value sequence length (same as seq_len_q for self-attn, 77 for cross-attn)"}}
inputs: {"attention_weights": {"shape": ["batch_size", "num_heads", "seq_len_q", "seq_len_kv"], "dtype": "bfloat16", "description": "Softmax-normalized attention scores [B, H, Q, K]"}, "value": {"shape": ["batch_size", "num_heads", "seq_len_kv", "head_dim"], "dtype": "bfloat16", "description": "Value matrix [B, H, K, D]"}}
outputs: {"output": {"shape": ["batch_size", "seq_len_q", "hidden_size"], "dtype": "bfloat16", "description": "Attention output [B, Q, H*D] ready for output projection"}}
reference:
import torch

@torch.no_grad()
def run(
    attention_weights: torch.Tensor,
    value: torch.Tensor,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    """
    Compute fused attention output: attention_weights @ value with transpose and reshape.
    
    Args:
        attention_weights: Softmax-normalized attention scores [B, H, Q, K]
        value: Value matrix [B, H, K, D]
        
    Returns:
        output: Attention output [B, Q, H*D] ready for output projection
    """
    batch_size = attention_weights.shape[0]
    seq_len_q = attention_weights.shape[2]
    num_heads = 20
    head_dim = 64
    hidden_size = num_heads * head_dim
    
    # Core attention matmul: [B, H, Q, K] @ [B, H, K, D] -> [B, H, Q, D]
    attn_output = torch.matmul(attention_weights, value)
    
    # Transpose: [B, H, Q, D] -> [B, Q, H, D]
    attn_output = attn_output.transpose(1, 2).contiguous()
    
    # Reshape: [B, Q, H, D] -> [B, Q, H*D]
    attn_output = attn_output.reshape(batch_size, seq_len_q, hidden_size)
    
    return attn_output
